shots.alt: The summary page of the sample report: a one-sentence governing thought, three headline numbers, and the recommendation. (PDF page 4.)
shots.caption: The summary stands alone. A reader who stops here knows what was found, what to do and what they are not obliged to buy.

shots.alt: The findings page: each finding states a claim, its evidence, how confident we are and what it means for the owner, plus one hypothesis that was ruled out. (PDF page 6.)
shots.caption: Every finding shows its evidence and how sure we are, and one is a hypothesis the evidence ruled out.

shots.alt: The recommendation page: a conditional proceed with two checkable conditions, what would change the recommendation, and what the next phase produces. (PDF page 7.)
shots.caption: The recommendation says what has to be true first, and what would change it.

shots.alt: A chart of management hours per week for three layers of the agency, now and with a larger deal, against capacity, with the over-capacity gaps labeled. (PDF page 11.)
shots.caption: The model behind the central finding, with its assumptions and its limits stated.

shots.alt: The appendix describing four rounds of questions put to the owner, and the gap between what they said and what the evidence showed. (PDF page 13.)
shots.caption: How the diagnosis works: the questions asked, and where what the owner says and what the evidence shows come apart.

shots.alt: A checklist mapping each item promised in the written list to the page of the report that meets it. (PDF page 14.)
shots.caption: The written list the guarantee covers, and where each item is met.
